room.name: Town Square
room.intro: You are at the town square.

room.name: Cobble Stone Path
room.intro: You are on a cobble stone path. Grass is growing between the cobble stones.

room.name: Quiet Inn
room.intro: You enter the inn, there is a soft candle lighting the entrance. Floorboards creak as you walk around.

room.name: Church Steps
room.intro: You are at the steps of the Church. The granite steps are old and the gargoyles peer down at you.
